THE GREED, MANIPULATION, AND COVER-UP OF THE EVIL FAMILY!

Kim Saeron’s tragic downfall wasn't a sudden collapse — it was a slow unraveling, rooted in betrayal and masked by lies. Drowning in debt from her father’s massive bankruptcy, Saeron silently bore the burden, while her own family denied everything. Instead, they pointed fingers outward, even dragging her ex-boyfriend from five years ago — the innocent and wealthy Kim Soo Hyun — into a fabricated narrative.

🔥🔥🔥
[Exclusive] Kim Saeron Confirmed to Have Lost 200 Million Won Due to FATHER’S Bankruptcy
“Played Role of BREADWINNER”

According to court records, Saeron was listed as a creditor in her father’s personal bankruptcy case in 2020, with a 250 million won claim. Her father, A, left debts to over 20 creditors, blaming failed business ventures during COVID-19. His bankruptcy was finalized in 2023.

Despite her rising fame, Saeron was forced to take on her family's debts, relying on loans from friends and industry colleagues. She even invested in a family-run restaurant that shuttered in 2024 due to unpaid rent.

Following her DUI accident in 2022, she was hit with more financial burdens — legal fees and compensation costs. At her trial, her lawyer revealed she supported her family as the main breadwinner.

A former neighbor shared, “She often cried alone on the stairs, showing her wrists. She was under too much pressure.”

One acquaintance added, “She worked non-stop — cafés, bars, coaching — and even worried about rent. She repaid a 50 million won debt last year with help from her agency.”

Even her private social media hinted at her suffering. And still, rather than face the truth, the family masked their role — feeding off her labor, burying their guilt, and weaving lies.

They didn’t just let her fall.
They pushed her.

ABISO SA MGA MOTORISTA!

READ: Pansamantalang isasara sa mga motorista ang ilang kalsada sa paligid ng Rizal Park sa Manila para sa pagdiriwang ng Independence Day bukas, June 12.

Sa abiso ng @MMDA, isasara ang northbound at southbound lanes ng Roxas Boulevard mula Buendia hanggang P. Burgos Drive mula 5:00 am hanggang 11:00 am.

Sarado rin ang mga sumusunod na kalsada sa mga nabanggit na oras:

• Bonifacio Drive (mula P. Burgos - Anda Circle) 
• TM Kalaw (mula Taft Avenue - Roxas Blvd.)
• P. Burgos (mula Taft Ave. - Roxas Blvd.)
• Finance Road (Taft Ave. - P. Burgos Drive)
• Maria Orosa (from TM Kalaw - P. Burgos Drive)

Samantala, sarado naman sa mga motorista ang Katigbak Drive, Independence Road, at South Road mula 12:01 am hanggang 11:30 am. | RH 29 @boy_gonzales, DZRH News

📷: National Historical Commission of the Philippines
